span.p: PRIMARY MODEL — Single Governed Quota Pool (per region / quota family)

span.p:
No — narrow EXCEPTION
Azure Quota Group limit
or mandatory Prod-isolation

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: EXCEPTION TOPOLOGY — Two Quota Groups (used ONLY when single pool is impossible)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Prod-only Quota Group
Prod CRG quota isolated from NonProd surge

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Shared NonProd + DR Quota Group
Effective NonProd Ceiling = Group Limit − DR Floor

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Policy decision:
can one governed pool
cover Prod + NonProd/CVAL + DR?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
One pool covers Prod + NonProd/CVAL + DR
allocation by logical earmarks, not physical groups

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Earmark: Prod_Reserved_Floor
floor below which Prod quota cannot be reduced
protects production growth buffer

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Earmark: DR_Earmark_vCPU
protects DR capacity
= MAX over source portions (max-not-sum, A.6)
NOT the sum of concurrent DR demands

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
NonProd / CVAL Allocatable Headroom
= Pool Limit − Prod_Reserved_Floor − DR_Earmark_vCPU
also funds quota-neutral emergency transfers

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Tier 2 Emergency Transfer is quota-neutral:
NonProd reduction releases quota to the SAME pool
that DR expansion consumes → net change ≈ 0

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Exception rationale: retained only where Azure Quota Group
limits or a governance boundary prevent one pool.
Same earmark semantics apply within the shared group.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
max-not-sum (Appendix D, formula A.6):
DR_Earmark_vCPU = MAX over source DR portions,
because DR events are treated as non-concurrent
